ideas.idea: List the actual routes with their grades as text on the guides page, ideally each on its own page
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so there is no content to read or quote.

ideas.idea: Add a short text intro to the home page describing what the site covers
ideas.why: The home page has only an h1 and a button, but a generic 'add an intro' suggestion has little specific effect.

ideas.idea: Keep only one of robots.txt Disallow or noindex for /admin
ideas.why: /admin being both disallowed and noindex is a deliberate, correct choice, and the report itself allows leaving it as is.

ideas.idea: Declare the real domain and add an absolute canonical link per page
ideas.why: No canonical exists anywhere and the only domain is in the sitemap, so per-page canonicals are a concrete missing item.

ideas.idea: Resolve the sitemap/noindex conflict by removing /guides from the sitemap if the noindex is deliberate
ideas.why: This restates the known noindex-on-/guides problem and only adds a conditional alternative.
